cards.front: Recall a key point about Prepositions and Conjunctions
cards.back: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for prepositions and conjunctions. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons.

cards.front: What should you know about gcse spanish exam tips?
cards.back: Por vs para is a common exam topic: por = reason/cause, para = purpose/destination. Use prepositions correctly after verbs (depender de, pensar en). Use conjunctions to link ideas and create complex sentences. Use connecting words for fluency.
the negation (e.g. No veo a nadie en la calle)

cards.front: What does la doble negación mean?
cards.back: the double negation (e.g. No tengo nada que hacer)

cards.front: What does las palabras interrogativas mean?
cards.back: the question words (e.g. ¿Dónde vives? ¿Cómo te llamas?)

cards.front: What does los signos de interrogación mean?
cards.back: the question marks (e.g. Usa ¿ al principio de la pregunta)
the adjectives (e.g. Los adjetivos concuerdan en género y número)
the comparison (e.g. España es más grande que Portugal)
the superlative (e.g. Es la mejor ciudad del mundo)

cards.front: What does la voz pasiva con se mean?
cards.back: the passive with se (e.g. Se habla español aquí)

cards.front: What does las oraciones relativas mean?
cards.back: the relative clauses (e.g. La ciudad donde vivo es bonita)

cards.front: What does el estilo indirecto mean?
cards.back: the reported speech (e.g. Dijo que vendría mañana)

cards.front: What does las perífrasis verbales mean?
cards.back: the verbal periphrases (e.g. Tengo que estudiar más)
Writing task: Write about common prepositions (a, de, en, por, para), conjunctions (y, o, pero, porque), connecting words.
